findings: (1) Scope holds. `git diff --name-only 4b87484...HEAD` in the worktree lists 13 files, all on the owned list: scripts/{rhythm,clicks,click_attack_ab,phrase_timing}.py, tests/test_{rhythm,clicks,click_attack_ab,phrase_timing}.py, docs/spec/sprints/RHYTHM_S2.md and docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261006-s2/rhythm_clicks-{implementation,eval,eval-results,real-take}.json. No root-owned or foreign file is edited. The worktree status is clean.

(2) No forbidden writes. Nothing in /Users/jess/git/video-utils/artifacts/runs/20261006T034521Z-a0def0c43eac is newer than 2026-10-06 05:34. denoised.wav still hashes to cb8a3fa5…e879e, matching the receipt. The diff adds no subprocess, network, download or daemon code. Lane outputs sit under the gitignored artifacts/s2/rhythm_clicks/. Both CLIs refuse an artifacts/runs output root.

(3) Sealing order and code identity verified. sha256 of rhythm.py, phrase_timing.py, click_attack_ab.py, clicks.py, the three test files and benchmark_holdout.py match preregistered values. The preregistration was committed at 12:17:34Z. Sealed runs started after it.

(4) Test counts reproduced with .venv python on all modules: 'Ran 111 tests in 243s, OK (skipped=3)'. The three skips are only the sealed D3/P2/A-B gates. The lane summary should state dependency-gated skips rather than only the sealed P2 skip.

(5) Tests exercise real behaviour. D1 checks constant grids give |drift_ppm| ≤ 250. D2 covers 9 dev drift cases and recovers each within 10%. D4 checks abstention under 6 events and on silence. C2 compares SHA-256 digests. P1 and P2 run real analyze() and phrase_timing.measure() on generated audio.

(6) Numbers reproduced independently. A numpy quadratic fit of 197 retained real-take tracked events gives drift 1.6707 ppm/s (receipt 1.6706), rms 4.0425 ms (4.0425), constant-period rms 4.2145 ms (4.2145) and OLS SE 0.4069 ppm (0.4069).
(7) Claim classes are mostly sound. Every synthetic result is labelled M-syn and every real-take block M-real unvalidated, with inferences marked 'I:'. All unknowns are documented.

(8) Robustness concern on the real-take label. drift_ppm 1.67 ± 0.41 is labelled 'strong_drift_evidence' but AR(1) autocorrelation 0.32 may inflate SE to 0.57 ppm. Consider renaming or adding autocorrelation-aware SE before operator-facing use.

(9) Doctrine tension. On real takes, phrase_timing publishes tendency_label 'ahead_of_click' / 'behind_click' without calibration. Suggest nulling tendency_label when run_kind == real_take or when physical latency is uncalibrated.
(10) 32 Hz and bounds. The diff adds no high-pass or notch. The probes keep 32.70 Hz content. FFmpeg calls go through existing bounded paths with timeouts.
(11) All five branch commits are unsigned, while main's history is signed. Root must re-sign during integration per custody practices.
(12) Minor drift-seed behaviour documented: fallback to operator's --bpm when neither grid nor periodicity is available, labelled as 'operator_declared_approximate_bpm'.
